name: Entomology PhD
detailsNote: Official application page confirms Fall 2027; stale Fall 2025 line remains below. GRE and current central fee/new TOEFL minima inaccessible.

requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s, GPA 3.0 last two years; strong biology and recommended statistics, physics, organic chemistry, calculus and computing. Non-native speakers must speak with faculty for verbal assessment. Advisor contact helpful but admission without one possible; meetings/rotations arranged afterward. GRE not established for primary program; dual-title GRE requirements not borrowed. Fee waiver: Program explicitly invites fee-waiver requests by email; no nationality restriction stated, confirm international eligibility. Current amount not established; central fee page 403.
documents: Program questions: motivation/program fit 150 words; preparation/research 400; research/faculty fit 300; goals 200; nonacademic activity 100

english.toefl: 80 iBT, speaking 19 (published legacy scale); revised paper total 60
english.note: IELTS Academic. Degree from listed countries exempts; foreign English medium alone not stated. Faculty verbal assessment required for non-native speakers. Current central new-scale requirements inaccessible.
